title: Austin: Infrastructure, Hospital, Tourism Plans
summary:
*   **Infrastructure & Transportation:** Received a report on the "Build Austin Program," focusing on future infrastructure and transportation projects.
*   **City Hospital Status:** An update was provided on the ongoing workplan for Brackenridge Hospital.
*   **Tourism & Convention Center:** Reviewed operations and finances of the Convention Center and Visitors Bureau, introducing a new director for the bureau.
